description:
All roads lead to fun with the Vortex F1 folding scooter. This kick scooter features a compact folding frame, Max Grip deck and brake,soft foam grips, and quick-release adjustable height complete with three lock-in pins. Experience the fun, convenience, and performance of the Vortex F1!
Folds up for compact storage and transport with easy folding design, perfect for storing in a school locker or under a bus seat.
Full-coverage MaxGrip™ on the alloy deck and steel brake provide smooth non-slip riding.
Tool-free height adjustment has three different lock-in points to fit a wide range of riders.
Heavy-duty steel frame supports children 5+ up to 176 lbs.
95 mm wheels with durable ABEC-7 bearings and soft foam grips.
